title: Sculk Locator
description: Helps Locate Sculk Shreikers in Ancient Cities
body:
Often when we go to the ancient city, while exploring even at the slightest noise the Warden spawns. Covering the Sculk Shreikers with wool stops the Warden from spawning however finding them in the darkness is another tough job. This datapack solves the problem. With Echo Shards, Amethyst Shards and an End Rod, craft the Sculk Locator. On right clicking it, it will highlight all the Sculk Shreikers in a 15 block radius and 2 blocks above and below. On going close to it the highlight will go and you can cover the block with wool and enjoy looting the Ancient City!
